question: Will the Milwaukee Brewers win the 2026 World Series?

calls.reasoning: Polymarket's exactly-matching contract (Brewers to win 2026 WS, closes 2026-10-31, ~$2.06M volume) trades at 0.62 Yes; the companion Rays contract is at 0.37. Sportsbooks: FanDuel BRS -170 / TB +185, DraftKings -160 / +140, about 60-62% with the bookmaker margin removed. Base rate for a moderately favored team with home-field advantage in a 7-game series is about 55-60%. Brewers: MLB-best 103-59, NLCS sweep of the Dodgers, Misiorowski (1.80 ERA) in Game 1, home field. Rays: Rasmussen dominant (11-0, 1.73 ERA after the All-Star break; 3 ER in three playoff starts), Peralta, ALCS comeback; Misiorowski's October has been shakier and his workload is far past previous levels. Settled near the market at 0.61.
